title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Using pBIOZOL and Qiagen RNeasy Kit
author: Marc T. J. Johnson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4rfgv3n
materials: Grind tissue to a powder in liquid nitrogen.
Discard the flow-through from the collection tube.
Then incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00 .

steps.title: Initial RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1.3 mL of cold (4 °C) pBIOZOL reagent for up to 100 mg of frozen ground tissue.

steps.title: Incubate and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 00:05:00 at Room temperature, laying the tube horizontally to maximize surface area, then centrifuge for 00:10:00 in a microcentrifuge at Room temperature.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 5 Molarity (M) NaCl and 300 µL chloroform, then centrifuge for 00:10:00.

steps.title: First Aqueous Phase Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml RNase-free tube.

steps.title: Second Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube until the phases mix and appear cloudy, then centrifuge for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Second Aqueous Phase Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml RNase-free tube.

steps.title: Third Aqueous Phase Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml RNase-free tube.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Pour the contents of the tube into a Qiagen mini RNA spin column (pink) until the column is almost filled with liquid. Repeat this process until all liquid from the tube(s) has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash Spin Column
steps.instruction: Wash the spin column by applying the following solutions, repeating the sequence one time:

substeps.instruction: Apply 700 µL of solution RW1 to the spin column.
Apply 500 µL of solution RPE to the spin column.

steps.title: Dry Silica Membrane
steps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed for 00:02:00 to remove remaining liquid from the silica membrane.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5 ml conical bottom microcentrifuge tube, add 30 µL – 50 µL of RNase-free water to the column, and spin at maximum speed for 00:01:00 to collect RNA solution.

steps.title: Resuspend and Transfer RNA
steps.instruction: Mix by briefly vortexing or flicking the bottom of the tube until the sample is thoroughly re-suspended, then transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL RNase-free tube.

steps.title: Acid Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube vigorously, add an equal volume of 5:1 acid phenol:chloroform, and incubate at 20 °C for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol Wash
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 24:1 chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the aqueous phase and vortex until the phases mix and appear cloudy.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1/2 volume of 100 % ethanol and incubate the tube at 20 °C for 00:03:00.
